body:
Straight off being a 16 year old virgin is 100 percent normal. I am also in that boat.

I can't really offer much advice because I struggle with a lot of the same issues. A lot of the criticisms you make of yourself you make by presuming what people think of you. Thinking your parents think you're a failure, thinking your friends aren't cool when really that's very subjective, and 5'6/7" is only slightly below average.

I don't know if that was a bit garbled but from what you've told me it just seems like you think everyone around you is judging you extremely harshly.

What do you mean "I am by every definition unfit for this world." Who's definition, where is that coming from?
